request.what: Fund Hydra v2 production hardening and performance improvements through four workstreams: performance optimization, operational excellence, ecosystem support, and maintenance/developer experience.

claims.claim: Hydra is described as the only production-grade Layer 2 on Cardano and the only production-ready scaling solution that gives Cardano sub-second finality with L1-grade settlement guarantees.
The proposal states Hydra is already running or has powered workloads for Delta DeFi, Masumi, Hydra Doom, Glacier Drop, Intersect voting infrastructure, VTech Labs, Blockfrost, and Midgard.
The proposal says Hydra provides sub-second finality, near-zero or zero internal fees, high throughput, and settlement anchored to Cardano L1.
The proposal asserts Cardano L1 has over two hours of finality, approximately $0.17 payment fees, and roughly 7 to 10 TPS, making some high-performance applications uncompetitive on L1.
The proposal claims a single Hydra Head can process up to 1,000+ TPS in payment benchmarks and that aggregate throughput scales close to linearly across independent Heads.
The proposal claims Hydra can attract and retain builders by making DeFi, agent commerce, gaming, micropayments, point of sale, and verifiable information processing viable on Cardano.

The proposal states Hydra activity can increase L1 fee accrual through head opening, fund addition or removal, closure, settlement transactions, and optional routing of internal fees to the L1 treasury.

The proposal says the work advances treasury KPIs for TVL, monthly active users, monthly transactions, throughput capacity, reliability and uptime, and annual protocol revenue, and aligns with Pillars 1, 2, 4, and 5.
The proposal states the ₳5,100,781 ask will be milestone-gated with independent third-party assurance and Intersect administrative treasury governance.
The proposal claims delays could cause current or prospective Hydra users to migrate to competing chains and make attracting new builders to Cardano difficult.

summary: The document requests ₳5,100,781 for Hydra v2 hardening and adoption work, presenting strong technical and ecosystem claims but mostly as proposer assertions, with limited budget, feasibility, alternatives, failure-mode, and community-impact detail in the supplied text.
